heroHeadline: Protesters Demand Election Re-Run Over Ballot Shortage After June 3 Vote
heroSubtitle: South Korean protesters continued demonstrations demanding a re-run of the June 3 local elections following a ballot shortage controversy that cast doubt on the vote's integrity. Demonstrators allege shortfalls of ballots in certain districts suppressed voter participation and undermined the legitimacy of results, calling on electoral authorities to address the discrepancy or order a fresh vote.
